subject: BlueWave: SDK compatibility and short-term shim request
messages:
From: Emma Barnes <emma@bluewaveanalytics.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:15:00Z
Subject: SDK change noticed in 2.0 - request for compatibility plan

Hi Aditya / Vanessa,

Hope you’re both well. We’re seeing a regression for a handful of customers after updating to Redwood SDK 2.0 (breaking change in the config serialization layer). The issue surfaces when our connector talks to hosted endpoints and causes metadata to be dropped during streaming initialization. Impact: 3 paying customers in production (two on US west, one on EU).

We asked our eng team to produce a short diff and a compatibility matrix (attached): bluewave-sdk-diff.patch and compat-matrix.xlsx. In short, we need one of the following ASAP:
- a short-term compatibility shim or toggle on Redwood’s side so our older adaptor enum remains accepted; or
- a maintained 2.x compatibility branch from Redwood that we can point to for immediate fixes while we migrate; or
- clear deprecation timeline + migration steps and an internal contact to coordinate a fast rollout.

Can you confirm your semver and deprecation policy for SDK surface changes? Our customers are asking for a clear window (30/60/90 days) before removals. We’d like to set expectations with them by EOD tomorrow if possible.

We’re open to contributing a patch if you can accept a partner PR (and sign a short CLA). What would help most right now is:
1) confirmation of a temporary toggle or maintained branch (timeline + owner)
2) codified deprecation window for SDK-breaking changes
3) a brief sync (30m) to triage and assign owners

Thanks — I’ll be on calls most of the morning but can do a late afternoon slot if that works for you.

—
Emma Barnes
Head of Integrations, BlueWave Analytics
emma@bluewaveanalytics.com
Attachments: bluewave-sdk-diff.patch (text), compat-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma@bluewaveanalytics.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-28T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SDK change noticed in 2.0 - request for compatibility plan

Emma — thanks for the clear reproduction and the attachments. Appreciate the fast heads-up. I’ve reviewed the diff at a high level and agree this looks like an unintentional breaking change in the config->proto serialization path that slipped through.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Quick triage sync tomorrow (2026-10-29) at 10:00 PT — 30 minutes. Marcus will join to scope the engineering effort.
2) We’ll open an internal incident with the runtime team and a short-term branch (if feasible) to accept the older enum values. If branch isn’t feasible in 48 hours, we’ll prioritize a runtime toggle controlled by feature flags for affected tenants.
3) We’ll publish a short partner-facing note that outlines our semver policy and deprecation windows (draft within 24 hours).
4) If BlueWave can provide a PR and sign the CLA, we’ll fast-track review and test it against our CI.

Can you confirm the three impacted customers by name or anonymized ID and the urgency per-customer (P1/P2)? That will help us triage capacity.

I’m looping Vanessa (partnerships) and Marcus (eng lead) to this thread so we have the right owners. We’ll follow up with the triage meeting invite and an initial incident ticket link.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@bluewaveanalytics.com>

Thanks Aditya — we can do the 10:00 PT triage on 10/29. For context:
- Affected customers: Acme Retail (P1), MeadowHealth (P2), and NovaEdge (P2, EU). Acme is on a revenue-impacting path and has a few large sessions failing.
- We have a short internal patch that reinstates the previous enum mapping and would be happy to open a PR if Redwood can accept it under a CLA. Patch is small and includes unit tests. Attached is an example stack trace in the compat matrix.

Preferable outcomes for us in order:
A) short-term toggle/flag on Redwood that restores old behavior for affected tenants for 60 days while we migrate;
B) maintained Redwood 2.x branch that includes the compatibility fix;
C) clear 60-day deprecation with migration steps and a runtime migration guide.

We can also commit two engineers for a week to aid in testing if that would speed things up. Please advise on the CLA process — we can sign whatever Redwood uses for partner PRs.

—
Oliver Shaw
Platform Engineering Lead, BlueWave Analytics
oliver.shaw@bluewaveanalytics.com

Subject: Re: SDK change noticed in 2.0 - request for compatibility plan

Emma / Oliver — thanks for the triage yesterday and for the extra context. Summary and proposed plan from Redwood: 

1) Ownership + timeline- Marcus Lin (cc) will own the engineering work for the short-term fix. We’ll open INF-4821 (link below) and aim to have a deployed toggle for affected tenants within 72 hours of the ticket being live. If toggle isn’t sufficient, we’ll maintain a short-term patch branch for 60 days.

2) Deprecation window- Redwood will institute a partner-facing 60-day deprecation window for SDK-breaking changes going forward (we will publish a formal policy doc). For this incident we’ll treat the change as "paused" until we complete the mitigation for the three impacted accounts.

3) Partner PRs and CLA- We are happy to accept partner PRs. We have a light partner CLA; Vanessa, can you send the CLA template to BlueWave? Aditya and Marcus will review any PRs under an expedited 48-hour SLA for patch-sized changes.

4) Next steps and cadence- Actions: open INF-4821 (engineering), draft partner advisory and migration steps (product), create a short QA matrix for the three customers and invite BlueWave eng to the sandbox test (we will share ephemeral creds).
- Working session scheduled: 2026-11-02T17:00:00Z (30m) — invite to follow.
- Point contacts: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com) for engineering, Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com) for partnership/CLA.

5) Accountability and rollback- If the toggle/branch approach does not resolve errors within 5 business days, Redwood will provide a temporary credit for affected tenants equivalent to 30% of the incremental cost for the outage period (we’ll draft terms with finance).

Links / references:
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/BW-EXP-931

Attachments: none in this message; original bluewave attachments are preserved above.

We’ll follow up with the incident ticket and the CLA; Vanessa, can you take point on sending the CLA and scheduling the Nov 2 session?

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
